extraMeanings.en: to break a law, rule, or agreement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company breached the terms of the contract by delivering the goods late.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket, malları geç teslim ederek sözleşme şartlarını ihlal etti.

extraMeanings.en: a sculpture of a person's head and shoulders
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A marble bust of the composer stood in the entrance hall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Giriş holünde bestecinin mermerden bir büstü duruyordu.

extraMeanings.en: a woman's chest, or its measurement around the breasts
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The dress was a little too tight around the bust.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Elbise göğüs kısmında biraz fazla dardı.

extraMeanings.en: to hire a vehicle such as a plane, boat, or bus for private use
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team chartered a plane to fly to the tournament.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Takım, turnuvaya uçmak için bir uçak kiraladı.

extraMeanings.en: relating to the direct observation and treatment of patients
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new drug performed well in clinical trials.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni ilaç klinik denemelerde iyi sonuç verdi.

extraMeanings.en: a small metal fastener that holds two parts together
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The clasp on her necklace had broken.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kolyesinin tokası kırılmıştı.

extraMeanings.en: a loud rattling noise made by hard objects hitting each other
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We heard the clatter of dishes coming from the kitchen.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mutfaktan gelen tabak takırtısını duyduk.

extraMeanings.en: to give someone advice, especially professionally
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The therapist counsels patients dealing with grief.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Terapist, yas yaşayan hastalara danışmanlık verir.

extraMeanings.en: to make an illegal copy of something to deceive people
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Gangs were counterfeiting designer handbags and selling them online.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çeteler marka çantaların taklitlerini yapıp internette satıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to analyze and judge something in detail
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Students were asked to critique each other's essays.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğrencilerden birbirlerinin denemelerini eleştirmeleri istendi.

extraMeanings.en: to campaign vigorously for a cause
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She has crusaded for years against animal cruelty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yıllardır hayvanlara eziyete karşı mücadele veriyor.

extraMeanings.en: a preset option that is used automatically unless changed
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The software uses English as the default language.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yazılım varsayılan dil olarak İngilizceyi kullanır.

extraMeanings.en: to yield to another's opinion or wishes out of respect
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I defer to your greater experience in these matters.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu konularda senin daha fazla tecrübene saygıyla uyuyorum.

extraMeanings.en: to grant a title, honour, or right on someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The university conferred an honorary degree on the scientist.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Üniversite bilim insanına fahri bir unvan verdi.

extraMeanings.en: to change from a gas into a liquid by cooling
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Steam condenses into water when it touches the cold window.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Buhar soğuk cama değdiğinde yoğunlaşıp suya dönüşür.

extraMeanings.en: expressing praise or admiration
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The reviews of her performance were highly complimentary.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Performansıyla ilgili yorumlar oldukça övgü doluydu.

extraMeanings.en: the tendency to obey or agree with others too readily
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her quiet compliance made her an easy target for bullies.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sessiz uysallığı, onu zorbalar için kolay bir hedef yapıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to have to deal with a difficult situation
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Firefighters had to contend with strong winds as they fought the blaze.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İtfaiyeciler yangınla mücadele ederken güçlü rüzgarlarla başa çıkmak zorunda kaldılar.

extraMeanings.en: to admit defeat in a contest or election
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The candidate conceded the election late that night.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Aday o gece geç saatte seçim yenilgisini kabul etti.

extraMeanings.en: to make a sound quieter or less resonant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Thick carpets deadened the sound of footsteps.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kalın halılar ayak seslerini boğuyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the quality of showing firm belief or being convincing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She argued her case with great conviction.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Davasını büyük bir kararlılıkla savundu.

extraMeanings.en: a person who plays a small but necessary part in a large organization
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He felt like just a cog in the machine at the huge corporation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O dev şirkette kendini sadece çarkın bir dişlisi gibi hissediyordu.
